entries.objective: pre-event win probability plus margin/total distributions for NFL games, as a private research forecast compared (never blended) with no-vig market probabilities
entries.sourceRights: public JSON endpoint, no key, no credits; point-in-time snapshots with attribution — registered source (P148), respectful 1s spacing
entries.featureCutoff: strength state at the assembly clock; every training row strictly precedes the declared train/test boundary
limitations: PRESEASON: abstains entirely — starter participation, roster churn, depth-chart uncertainty make the regular-season fit unfounded; a separate evidence-backed preseason update would be its own versioned model
totals are league climatology (no team scoring signal)
no injury/weather/rest adjustment in v1 — those are shadow-run INPUT states, surfaced beside the forecast, never silently imputed
margin/total normality is an approximation; key-number mass (3, 7) is not modeled

entries.objective: winner probability baseline (research bar, not a product model)
entries.sourceRights: public JSON endpoint, no key, no credits; point-in-time snapshots with attribution — registered source; respectful 1s spacing

corpus.note: regular 1,230×3 exact; cup-final own phase; no ties possible

entries.featureCutoff: expanding pregame state only: prior finals' scores and venues; no injuries, no rosters, no rest modeling in v1
limitations: no injury/roster/rest information — a real gap, not a rounding error
postseason replay uses one frozen state (no intra-tournament updates)
cold starts enter at league mean; early-season predictions are weaker
margin/total are point estimates with MAE/RMSE, never calibrated probabilities
entries.publicActivation: OFF — founder decision; research readiness is not product activation

entries.objective: private pre-event 1X2 + exact-score + total-goals distributions for EPL fixtures; research comparison against three-way no-vig markets only after an authorized snapshot exists
entries.sourceRights: api-sports licence; free-tier seasons 2022-2024 only (2026 refused: 'Free plans do not have access to this season')
entries.featureCutoff: INCOMPLETE — no model card; cutoff discipline enforced by the replay runner
limitations: draw probability derives from the Poisson grid, not a dedicated draw parameter — the D-column calibration in the report is the honest check
promoted-club cold start = league average until real 2026-27 results fold in
no lineups, injuries, congestion, or European-schedule features — stated, never imputed
independence assumption between home/away goals (the deferred Dixon–Coles τ is the known correction)

entries.objective: abstaining bout-winner baseline (research bar, not a product model)
entries.sourceRights: public JSON endpoint, no key, no credits; point-in-time snapshots with attribution — registered source

corpus.note: 25 draw/NC preserved; 1046 fighters by provider id

entries.featureCutoff: prior decisive in-corpus bouts only; winner flags are the only outcome field captured (method/round not in this shape)

abstention.rules: either fighter <3 prior decisive bouts OR idle >540d
abstention.note: coverage is a headline metric — exclusions shape the denominator and are counted here

limitations: in-corpus history only: no pre-Aug-2023 records, no method/round data, no reach/age/stance
weak signal is the honest finding: 0.679 vs 0.691 prior over 289 covered bouts — a real but small edge over listing-order priors, nowhere near a usable fight model
draw/no-contest never predicted; replacements/late changes not modeled
